newsitem.title: USA: Petroperu issues tender to buy 380,000 bbls of oil.
newsitem.headline: Petroperu issues tender to buy 380,000 bbls of oil.

text.p: Peruvian state oil company Petroperu is seeking to buy 380,000 barrels of crude oil for Aug 29-31 arrival, a Latin American trade source said Tuesday.
Offers are due Aug 6, with the award scheduled for Aug 7 on either an fob or cif basis.

Petroperu listed as possible candidates Colombia's Cano Limon, South Blend, Vasconia and Cusiana grades, Venezuela's Mesa, Lagotreco and Guafita, Ecuador's Oriente, Peru's Lote 8, Mexico's Isthmus, and Argentina's Rincon, Medanito and Escalante.
Peruvian purchase tenders have become infrequent since last year's sale of the La Pampilla refinery, which is now operated by Spain's Repsol.
The current tender is intended to supply the Talara refinery, which is still in state hands, the source said.
